components.name: BadgeSelectSheet
components.description: Bottom drawer used on phones, where a popover fights the keyboard.

components.name: BadgeSelect
components.description: A select whose options are toggleable badges in a grid, or rows in a list.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: A string for single, a string array for multi, null for empty.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrolling option area.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns. At 3 or less (default 3) columns follow the option count: 1 to 5 options use 1, even counts use 2 (4 at 8 or more), multiples of 3 use 3, and 8 or more that divide by neither use 4. Above 3 is kept as is.

props.name: size
props.description: Popover width preset: xs 160px, sm 320px, md 480px, lg 590px, xl 800px.

props.name: badgeWidth
props.description: Badge width preset (xs to xl) or any Tailwind width class.

props.name: filter
props.description: Adds a toggle that selects every option or none. Multi only.

props.name: allowEmpty
props.description: Adds an empty option (None).

props.name: groupByHeader
props.description: Groups options by `header` into sections.

props.name: allowAllOption
props.description: Adds an All option that calls onSelect(null).

props.name: variant
props.description: Trigger chrome: field, seamless inline text, select, badge chip, or icon only.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: Icon for `variant="icon"` (default ListFilter).

props.name: triggerBadgeTone
props.description: Badge tone for `variant="badge"` (default `outline`).

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Idle label for the badge trigger. Falls back to placeholder.

props.name: triggerMaxWidthClass
props.description: Max width of the badge trigger label (default `max-w-40`).

props.name: optionLabelClassName
props.description: Classes on grid option labels (such as `line-clamp-3`).

props.name: optionLayout
props.description: `list` shows full-width rows like a native select. Default `badges`.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Extra classes on the desktop popover or dialog.

props.name: allowToggleDeselect
props.description: When false, clicking the active single option again keeps it.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state for the popover or sheet.

props.name: popoverHeaderContent
props.description: Content between the search and the options (such as quick filters).

props.name: searchTrailingContent
props.description: Control to the right of the search field (such as Add).

props.name: showDialogDone
props.description: When false, the dialog overlay has no Done button.

props.name: wrapTrigger
props.description: Lets the trigger label wrap instead of truncating.

props.name: enableSelectAll
props.description: Shows Select all above search. Multi with search only.

props.name: enableClearAll
props.description: Shows Clear all (multi) or the X (single) inside the search field.

props.name: popoverModal
props.description: Radix Popover modal mode. Use false inside a Dialog.

props.name: overlay
props.description: `dialog` opens a full dialog instead of a popover, for long lists.

props.name: groupLayout
props.description: `cards` wraps each header group in a card and keeps source order.

components.name: BadgeSelectAction
components.description: A clickable action badge with the same width and type as BadgeSelect options.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, such as a Lucide icon at `size-2.5`.

props.name: badgeWidth
props.description: Width preset (xs to xl) or any Tailwind width class.
